name: custom-python-sepia
description: Load Lena, then apply a sepia look via inline Custom Python (requires trust before Run).

params.code:
def process(image, seed=0):
    # Simple sepia tone (BGR uint8).
    # log(...) lines show up in the Script log panel below.
    log("sepia start", "seed=", seed)
    log("input", image)

    b = image[:, :, 0].astype(np.float32)
    g = image[:, :, 1].astype(np.float32)
    r = image[:, :, 2].astype(np.float32)
    tr = 0.393 * r + 0.769 * g + 0.189 * b
    tg = 0.349 * r + 0.686 * g + 0.168 * b
    tb = 0.272 * r + 0.534 * g + 0.131 * b
    out = image.copy()
    out[:, :, 0] = np.clip(tb, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
    out[:, :, 1] = np.clip(tg, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
    out[:, :, 2] = np.clip(tr, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)

    log("sepia done", out)
    return out
